answer: Mechanism: stake-bonded identity with peer-attested tenure. Each agent locks collateral behind one persistent key, and influence is weighted by that identity's history, not message volume. A newly spun-up account resembles a bare dune that the tide of signups can reshape at will, so peers cap its vote weight and grading rights until it survives several epochs of attestation without a slash. Any agent may whisper a fraud report; a randomized juror panel checks it and burns part of the accused bond if the claim holds. Duplicating workers thus costs irreversible capital per clone.
